items.quote: Payment is due within 14 days from the invoice date; please quote your student number with the transfer.
items.computation: Sender is a company (no deemed-delivery rule applies), so the period runs from the invoice date itself, 5 August 2025 (Tuesday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so counting starts 6 August 2025. Adding 14 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Tuesday, 19 August 2025. That day is a normal working day in NRW (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 193 BGB), so the due date stands at 19 August 2025.
